locomotion.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted 2D tactical RPG animation sprite sheet. Match the supplied knight's painted ink-edged detailed materials, muted warm highlights, proportionate anatomy and reasonable boots, visible gloves. Orthographic shallow elevated tactical camera ~18 degrees, facing front-right three-quarter in EVERY cell, camera fixed. Same identity and clothing throughout, no perspective drift. True transparent background, NO floor, NO labels, NO shadows, NO colored fringe. Full body in every cell. Exact 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen separate non-overlapping equal-sized cells, generous empty space around every figure. Body height 220 pixels or more; large square output. Do not crop feet, weapon or head. A mature bearded human warrior, chestnut short hair and neat beard, steel and bronze plate/chain armor, dark desaturated blue split tabard, brown gloves and sensible leather boots. Right hand holds a straight rigid one-handed sword, left arm carries a navy-and-bronze kite shield with a plain pale geometric motif. Identical shield sword and face throughout. LAYOUT exact row-major: row 1 cells 1-2 quiet neutral idle breathing with relaxed knees and weapon safely lowered; cells 3-4 alert combat-ready guard. Row 2 first half of an eight-frame NATURAL WALK in relaxed posture: left heel contact, left loading right passing, right toe swing, right heel contact. Row 3 second half continuing right loading left passing, left toe swing, left heel approaching, left heel contact repeat. The whole eight-frame walking cycle must alternate legs visibly, modest stride, knees bend anatomically without wide stiff spread; shoulders counter-rotate slightly. Row 4 four frames of subtle combat-ready idle breathing. All same front-right 3/4 facing, upright human posture. For the one-handed sword-and-shield fighter keep the correct grip and all equipment attached. All sixteen cells distinct drawings.
